answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Each new task hashes the prior verified work; parallel histories are detectably forked. Trust accrues only through verified work; a willow of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady comet at 10 percent per epoch, and grove-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
